cnFiles..github/workflows/claudinite-ci.yml:
# Claudinite's CI gate, written by cn init. check runs the pinned engine's
# cn check world over the change: on an update PR that is the new engine
# against this repo, and on any other PR it refuses a moved pin or
# launcher. The update job dispatches this workflow on its PR's branch,
# since GitHub starts no pull_request run for a PR the job token opened;
# land then merges that PR once check is green.
name: claudinite-ci

on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ['src/**']
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr:
        description: The update PR this run checks, and lands when check passes
        type: string
        default: ""

permissions: {}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: who opened the change
        id: who
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PR_AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}
          PR: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          ACTOR: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: |
          base=origin/main
          case $EVENT in
            pull_request) author=$PR_AUTHOR ;;
            workflow_dispatch)
              if [ -n "$PR" ]; then
                case $PR in
                  *[!0-9]*) echo "::error::input pr must be a PR number, not $PR"; exit 1 ;;
                esac
                author=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR" --jq .user.login)
              else
                author=$ACTOR base=HEAD
              fi ;;
            *) author=$ACTOR base=HEAD ;;
          esac
          echo "author=$author" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "base=$base" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: download the pinned engine
        run: sh .claudinite/launch version
      - name: cn check world
        env:
          AUTHOR: ${{ steps.who.outputs.author }}
          BASE: ${{ steps.who.outputs.base }}
        run: .claudinite/bin/cn check world --pr-author "$AUTHOR" --base-ref "$BASE"

  land:
    needs: check
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pr != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: download the pinned engine
        run: sh .claudinite/launch version
      - name: cn update land
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR: ${{ inputs.pr }}
        run: .claudinite/bin/cn update land --pr "$PR" --sha "$GITHUB_SHA"
